description: Offline check of format and check digit for up to 100 EU VAT IDs or Swiss UIDs, without contacting any register. Fast and unlimited. It cannot tell whether a number is registered; use check_vat_id for that.

vat_ids.description: 1 to 100 VAT IDs or Swiss UIDs.

with_receipt.description: Optional, default false. Set true only when the user asks for a signed receipt of this check for their files.

name: validate_vat_format
title: Validate VAT ID format
